# yellowdog_machine_image_group (Resource)

Defines a group of functionally equivalent machine images across different provider/region environments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An image group holds the equivalent machine images for each cloud provider
# and region, typically one version of an image family. Add images to it with
# yellowdog_machine_image.
resource "yellowdog_machine_image_family" "example" {
  name      = "example-image-family"
  namespace = "example-namespace"
  os_type   = "LINUX"
  access    = "PRIVATE"
}

resource "yellowdog_machine_image_group" "example" {
  family_id = yellowdog_machine_image_family.example.id
  name      = "v1"
  os_type   = "LINUX"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `family_id` (String) Id of the MachineImageFamily this MachineImageGroup belongs to
- `name` (String) The user allocated name used to uniquely identify this machine image group within its family.
- `os_type` (String) The operating system type of all images within this machine image group.

### Optional

- `metadata_specification` (Map of String) A map of user-definable key-value pairs used to specify metadata keys and, optionally, values required to be on all images within the machine image group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the image group's YDID.
terraform import yellowdog_machine_image_group.example ydid:imggrp:000000:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
